study.question: Does an explicitly field-bound multiplicative target/history logit readout add useful signal beyond the incumbent normalized retrieval and 24 statistics, relative to equally sized additive and crossed-field readouts?
study.hypothesis: Observed: feature-only/pooled/DIN AUCs are 0.605004/0.610226/0.613362; match counts reach 0.616754, aligned decay 0.617149 and support statistics 0.618457. Joint-pair statistics (0.618352) and action summaries (0.617934) did not beat their support parent. Aligned shared retrieval (0.618521) exceeded crossed shared (0.618026), while blind static context (0.618603) only slightly exceeded adaptive context (0.618560). Latest availability/scale factorial best 0.618283 remains below that incumbent; its active-scale effect cannot be called evidence for useful missing-field binding. Source inspection shows the current final MLP receives a SUM of category and brand histories, not explicit target-by-field-pool products. Provisional mechanism: a small normalized, semantically bound bilinear logit readout may expose complementary low-order evidence with a shorter learning path. Neither an information-loss bottleneck nor useful transfer from an external system is established by these observations.

nearest_work.source_ref: unidot-paper-v1; arxiv:2608.16797v1; primary text SHA256 7714c79aba968b84d631bb677ca87a16614add7785fff830fd99b93e33b39727; section 4.4 lines 467-488, 4.5 lines 499-513, 5.3 Table 4 lines 683-748
nearest_work.difference: Inherit the idea of exposing candidate/retrieved-vector products directly. Source concatenates per-layer domain dots, Gram matrices and cross-bus dots to a nonlinear classifier. Here a single zero-initialized diagonal bilinear residual uses two existing field embeddings and unchanged parent attention, with normalized operands and only 32 new parameters. No dual buses, token mixing, layers/views, distillation, delay labels, optimizer or source split are transferred. Tiny-mode source ablations and ambiguous fusion results do not establish a local benefit. This is an adaptation of known interaction mechanisms, not a novelty or reproduction claim.

study.proposed_difference: For the new branch only, restrict parent shared attention weights to events with both history field IDs positive and renormalize by their positive mass. Pool raw category and brand embeddings separately, without action/recency offsets; normalize each pooled vector and each raw target-field embedding to unit L2 norm (eps 1e-8). Gate the entire branch to zero unless BOTH target IDs are positive and a pair-valid event with positive parent attention mass exists. This common mask avoids changing target-availability treatment between factorial cells. Aligned versus crossed exchanges the two pooled endpoints. Product uses sqrt(D)*(q elementwise p); additive uses (q+p)/sqrt(2), each flattened to 2D=32 features. A bias-free linear head with zero-initialized 32 coefficients adds a scalar to the unchanged parent logit. Parent forward is exactly recovered at initialization for finite inputs. No parent weight mask, event selection, output width, loss or optimizer changes. All cells compute all four feature maps; only selected gradients reach the loss. New branch is ineligible for missing targets and empty/pair-invalid histories. Known bilinear readout, no verified novelty claim.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: aligned_product validation AUC exceeds aligned_additive and the historical r0005-query_blind; stronger support also requires aligned_product > crossed_product.
Interaction prediction: (AUC aligned_product - AUC crossed_product) - (AUC aligned_additive - AUC crossed_additive) > 0. A generic extra-head benefit is insufficient for field-bound multiplication.

Secondary: report unweighted Logloss, all host slices with sample/positive/negative counts and exploratory labels; disclose AUC/Logloss tradeoffs and unstable or insufficient slices. No numerical significance claim from seed 42.

Source/formula invariants: residual exactly zero initially and on ineligible examples; normalized vectors and feature values finite for empty, zero and extreme finite score cases; no padded pooling mass; event permutation leaves outputs invariant. Diagnostics measure branch activation and head dependence only, not causal importance.

Expected trainable parameter count 17,133,379 total, 17,078,688 embeddings, 54,691 dense in all four cells (+32 versus incumbent). Measure wall/train/GPU time, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95 latency; no equal-compute or speedup claim.
falsifiers: If aligned_product fails to improve on both aligned_additive and the incumbent in paired validation repetitions, useful multiplicative residual evidence is not supported for this implementation. A single negative seed is provisional, not a universal mechanism refutation.
If crossed_product matches/beats aligned_product or the factorial interaction is nonpositive, semantic binding is unsupported even if an extra residual head improves AUC.

If additive cells improve equally, attribute evidence to a generic residual readout/conditioning rather than multiplication. If all new cells degrade, retain the incumbent and stop this branch pending a concrete diagnostic.

A zero/near-zero learned residual or inactive eligible feature branch makes a null AUC result uninformative about an active mechanism. Investigate that execution/optimization issue before generalizing.
Any finite-output, mask, initial-parent-invariance or parameter-matching violation invalidates comparison and requires repair; failed execution is not scientific counterevidence.

new pooling and normalization are common to all cells; their individual value is not isolated

The parent MLP may already recover useful interaction signals; extra exposure may be redundant or overfit.
An observed positive difference may come from zero-initialized optimization or embedding gradients, not loss of information in the parent MLP.
Host diagnostics use the first 512 validation impressions; their composition is not population evidence, and pretrained counterfactuals are not retraining contrasts.
Source tasks have different labels, domains and split policies. No industry system-level result transfers automatically.

Finite-precision softmax may assign zero mass to every pair-valid event when invalid-pair events dominate. All cells then gate the branch off identically; diagnostics count this condition. Float32 behavior and gradients cannot be executed in this coding environment.

knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Single-stage normalized diagonal bilinear target/history residual; 32 parameters, fixed parent retrieval. Full product/additive by aligned/crossed controls.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: No multi-layer FM Highway, buses, Gram blocks, fused domains, optimizer changes, delay heads or distillation. Adapt known affinity readout; novelty unverified.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: Aligned product fails against aligned additive/incumbent or has no positive binding interaction.
